testcase: MB-75507: the saved plan, whose index was dropped, is loaded and re-planned
MB-75507: the new plan replaces the saved plan
statements: SELECT RAW d.encoded_plan = b.doc.encoded_plan FROM QUERY_METADATA._system._query b JOIN QUERY_METADATA._system._query d ON KEYS b.origId WHERE meta(b).id = "mb75507_backup"

testcase: MB-75507: back up the new saved plan
statements: UPSERT INTO QUERY_METADATA._system._query (KEY k, VALUE v) SELECT "mb75507_backup" AS k, {"origId": meta(d).id, "doc": d} AS v FROM QUERY_METADATA._system._query d USE KEYS "ppn::mb75507_p1"
